pairs.question: Que sit ista terra nova?
pairs.answer: Ipsa est spiritalis Ierusalem, ipsa est terra promissionis quam vobis spiritaliter annuntiamus.
pairs.derivation: Author poses and answers his own question. Question follows the quoted Isaiah prophecy 'Ecce ego creo celos novos et terram nova(m)'; dropped the asking-narration framing 'Queritis, o Iudei,' leaving the bare interrogative. Answer: kept the two clauses that directly identify the terra nova, stripping the inline page marker '[p. 75]'; cut after 'annuntiamus' where the sentence turns from answering to elaboration ('in qua et spiritale sabbatum et spiritales hostie...'). No interior ellipsis.
